name.ja: 部分ピボットLU・Choleskyと反復改良
name.en: Pivoted LU, Cholesky and iterative refinement

caption.ja: 保存した12×12 SPD行列。反復改良の固定例に使います。 別の全図に示す誤差は厳密有理数解をbinary64へ丸めた参照との差です。対数表示だけ、厳密なゼロ誤差をfloat64.tinyに置いて表示します。
caption.en: The saved 12 x 12 SPD matrix used in the refinement examples. In the companion full figure, errors are measured against the exact-rational solution rounded to binary64; exact zeros are shown at float64.tiny for logarithmic display only.

name.ja: 有限次元線形方程式と行列分解

note.ja: 有限行列Aと右辺bの代数問題です。LU/Cholesky・混合精度改良・対称不定値鞍点系を固定例で検査し、連続PDEの解とは区別します。
note.en: Finite matrices A and right-hand sides b define algebraic problems. Fixed LU, Cholesky, refinement and symmetric-indefinite saddle controls are distinct from continuum PDE solutions.

equation_note.ja: SPD12、低ランク近特異8、Hilbert5、Wilkinson12を固定。binary32因子・三角解法とbinary64残差・補正の5回です。
equation_note.en: Fixed SPD matrix of size 12, a nearly singular rank-one matrix of size 8, Hilbert matrix of size 5 and Wilkinson matrix of size 12. Factors and triangular corrections use binary32; residuals use binary64, with five updates.

name.ja: 部分ピボットLU・Choleskyと反復改良
name.en: Pivoted LU, Cholesky and iterative refinement

note.ja: 独立の厳密有理数解と比較し、条件数・前進誤差・後退誤差・ピボット増大を分けます。
note.en: Exact-rational comparisons separate conditioning, forward and backward error, and pivot growth.

title.ja: 部分ピボットLU/Cholesky：実二進入力の厳密有理数参照
title.en: Pivoted LU and Cholesky: exact-rational references for actual binary input

assumptions.ja: 固定4行列の実binary64 A,bをFractionへ厳密変換し、有理数消去の解を最後にbinary64へ変換。LAPACKは別比較であり共有数値基盤を含みます。任意の悪条件行列に対する前進精度保証ではありません。
assumptions.en: The four fixed matrices use the actual binary64 A and b, converted exactly to Fractions. Rational elimination is exact, followed by a final binary64 rounding. Separate LAPACK comparisons share some numerical infrastructure. This is not a forward-accuracy guarantee for arbitrary ill-conditioned matrices.

note.ja: 小さい固定例のみ。一般の高条件数系で混合精度の収束は保証しません。
note.en: Small fixed examples only; convergence of mixed-precision refinement is not guaranteed for arbitrary matrices.

reference_note.ja: 実binary64入力をFraction有理数で厳密に解き、別のLAPACK DGESV/DPOSVへ照合。条件数・前進誤差・後退誤差を分離。 保存する有理数参照ベクトルは、厳密Fraction解の各成分をbinary64へ丸めたものです。
reference_note.en: Exact-rational solutions for the actual binary64 inputs and separate LAPACK DGESV/DPOSV comparisons. Conditioning, forward error and backward error are reported separately. Each saved reference component is the exact Fraction solution rounded to binary64.
